zh.title: 芝加哥奧黑爾機場設備故障一度延誤到港航班　FAA 已解除地面管制
zh.summary: 芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場 11 月 24 日發生設備故障，美國聯邦航空總署一度要求部分飛往當地的航班暫留出發地，改採地面延誤計畫後於當天下午解除管制。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）11 月 24 日下午一度要求部分飛往芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場（ORD）的航班暫留出發地，並非暫停奧黑爾機場所有航班起飛。FAA 隨後改採地面延誤計畫，讓部分飛往奧黑爾的班機延後起飛，並於芝加哥當地時間下午 4 時 47 分取消該計畫。
FAA 向芝加哥 ABC7 證實，設備故障期間確有部分航班延誤。地面延誤計畫取消後，FAA 另發公告，預估部分到港班機仍可能延誤或在空中等待最多約 30 分鐘；那是當時的預估，不是實際等待時間。FAA 的機場狀態頁只提供整體情況，旅客應向航空公司確認個別航班。

en.title: FAA lifts ground restrictions at Chicago O’Hare after equipment outage delays arrivals
en.summary: The FAA temporarily held some Chicago O’Hare-bound flights at their departure airports on November 24 after an equipment outage, then switched to a ground delay program that it canceled the same afternoon.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration briefly held some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) at their departure airports on November 24. It did not halt all departures from O’Hare. The FAA then assigned later departure times to some inbound flights under a ground delay program, which it canceled at 4:47 p.m. Chicago time.

The FAA confirmed to Chicago’s ABC7 that some flights were delayed during the outage. After canceling the ground delay program, the agency warned that some inbound flights could still face arrival delays or airborne holding of up to 30 minutes. That was a forecast, not a measure of actual wait times. The FAA’s airport status page reports general conditions; passengers should check with their airline for individual flights.

facts.claim: FAA temporarily held some O’Hare-bound flights at origin on November 24.
FAA switched to a ground delay program for flights arriving at O’Hare.
FAA canceled the ground delay program at 22:47 UTC, or 4:47 p.m. CST.
A subsequent advisory said users could expect arrival delays or airborne holding of up to 30 minutes; it did not report measured delays.
FAA told ABC7 that some flights were delayed during the equipment outage; the ground stop did not halt all O’Hare departures.
The FAA airport status page lists general conditions and recommends checking with the airline for flight-specific information.
NBC Chicago originally published this event at 21:35:37 UTC on November 24.
